findings.gate: Recheck of verified F-008 / CORE continuity persistence / evidence rule for counts

draft_evidence.quote: Twelve on the road, two of whom would not fight — a healer of Tide and a healer of no Path, on either end of the ten the wall counted, walking the same bearing for reasons that were their own

comparison_evidence.quote: ch18.md line 171 — either recast to the wall-count distinction ch17 now uses (two who are not on the count) or absorb Karis explicitly. The closing image is a fixed shape, so planning should confirm the wording before the author touches it.

findings.consequence: The repair changes `a line of ten` to `the ten the wall counted`, but it leaves the verified false proposition untouched: only two of the twelve would not fight. The wall-count distinction is precisely that Karis belongs to the ten because walking the site counts even when she does not swing. The revised suffix explains why a non-swinging researcher belongs to the operational ten; it does not turn her into a fighter or make the literal number two accurate. This is localized, but it sits in the fixed closing image and is the one verified r1 finding not actually closed by the r2 wording.
findings.repair_target: Line 173 only: make the number describe wall-count participation rather than who will fight, or otherwise account for Karis without changing the surrounding departure image.

concerns: Taste — causal-conjunction density remains high: `because` appears 53 times in 5,005 whitespace-counted words (10.6 per thousand), versus ch13 9.2, ch16 8.1, ch17 8.3, and ch15 7.9. This is house voice, but at this density its scaffold becomes audible.

Taste — the leaf offer remains at the outer edge of deferral: `It's a leaf. Older than the board. It says what the thing was built for.` gives Oryn the artifact's age and subject before she declines. It does not disclose the leaf's text or breach the prohibited outcome.

Taste — Oryn says Cael's owed rib reading is one reason she will walk beyond the two shared road-days, but completes that reading the same evening. Her other stated reason — ten people entering two Path-stopping places — carries the onward choice, so this is mild causal looseness rather than a failed obligation.

Taste / forward debt — the withholding ledger does not explicitly weigh Oryn's earlier `stop` instruction, and Cael withholds the inward result from Lira despite the established `Lira first` practice. Both debts remain available for the scheduled Chapter 22 payoff; neither is falsely closed here.

Taste — `It's the word` at line 161 still comments on `Noted` shortly after Cael's narration says `because it was the word` at line 139. The r1 target was technically replaced, and the earlier Vastin beat remains the meaningful one, but the echo is still noticeable.

Planning exception observed — `Seven holds north of here` remains geographically loose against B7's Millrace-as-third wording, but EXC-B8-CH18-3 explicitly approves reading it as the seven-stop route with three still owed; this is not a manuscript finding.
strengths: All eight strengths recorded in r1 survive the scoped repair. The fixed line remains verbatim at line 137 and still lands after the deep reading in near-dark, with Oryn looking at Cael rather than the ford.

The deep reading remains the chapter's strongest set piece: `Her current ... ran down through the twelve to the middle, to the place, and did not arrive. It went round.` It is staged from inside the patient, and the revision improves it by making the unlit lean-to mechanically load-bearing: the darkness lets the eye-cost be paid unseen. The wheel, ford, riverbed, bench, fading light, and healer's touch all do work rather than decorate.

Worldbuilding is done through mechanism and use. Tide becomes legible through fingers, current, reserve, contact, going-round, and recovery; Oryn's route becomes legible through patients, promises, ladder orders, elapsed days, and who may claim her time. There is no detachable lore lecture.

Oryn's full terms remain concrete and bounded at lines 37–51: seven route stops, four walked, three owed, two shared road-days, the day she turns north, and an explicit refusal of recruitment aimed past the six at Teague. Her independent want survives intact.
The two healers still price one another in a single look at line 21, with no explanatory dialogue; the passage preserves the r1 strength's restraint exactly.
Vastin's quiet human-track progression survives untouched: he accepts an order from Oryn and stands (line 29), then uses Cael's `Noted` at line 83. Progress is behavioral rather than announced.
The mule ruling remains clean and invisible: the crew arrives without it because it has been Oryn's since the fork (line 5), and it departs carrying her roll beside Karis's boxes (line 173).

The withholding paragraph at line 145 remains intact and remains the best moral-accounting passage: Cleon's warning, Cael's refusal to guess, respect for Oryn's complete finding, and the unresolved two-instrument disagreement all coexist without excusing the debt.

Tic discipline, reader-standard cleanliness, and closer variety all survive: one one-word paragraph, zero chapter hits for the listed §9 tics, zero banned words, and an image closer after Chapter 17's log.

There is no fight in Chapter 18, so the fight win-sentence test is not applicable. The diagnostic set piece is nevertheless memorable and causally choreographed; its outcome can be stated with the same clarity: Oryn's Tide removed her ability to explain the center by reaching a place where flow could only go around, while Cael's Rune-adjacent sense exposed the rival made-structure reading at the cost of his eyes.
